tagline.en: Create stories. Adapt them. Ship them.
tagline.zh: 让故事从灵感出发，走向小说、短剧、游戏与视频。

intro.en: Six MIT-licensed projects for writers and story creators. Write web fiction with AI skills inside Claude Code or Codex, turn a novel into short-drama scripts and storyboards, a playable game or a narrated video recap — or write in the browser at the ZenStory Workbench, no agent setup needed.
intro.zh: 六个 MIT 开源项目，给写小说和做故事的人。在 Claude Code、Codex 里用 AI skill 写网文，把小说改成短剧剧本与分镜、可玩的游戏，或者把视频做成解说成片；不想折腾 Agent，就直接在网页版 ZenStory 工作台里写。

category.primary: agent skills for story creation and adaptation
category.note: Story creation and adaptation is the shared use-case family. Skill packs, a host-specific plugin and the separate writing workbench are different product formats; web fiction and short drama are specializations, not model or host names.

en: Start with an idea, an existing manuscript or a chapter to revise. Oh Story supplies reusable fiction-writing workflows in a supported agent; the separate ZenStory workbench organizes writing in a hosted project workspace.

Choose the next form of your story: Drama Skills for short-drama scripts and shot planning, Novel to Game for an interactive game candidate, or Video Recap Skills for narrated recaps from footage. Bring source material and the rights to use it.
Already using DeepSeek Harness? Oh Story DSH brings the four skill packs into its workbenches. It is a community plugin for that host, not an extension installed into ordinary DeepSeek web chat.
zh: 从一个点子、一部已有小说或一章待修改的正文开始。Oh Story 在受支持的 Agent 中提供可复用写作流程；独立的 ZenStory 托管工作台则围绕项目组织写作。
按目标形态选工具：Drama Skills 生成短剧剧本与分镜规划，Novel to Game 制作互动游戏候选版本，Video Recap Skills 把视频素材组织成旁白解说。准备好源材料及使用权。
已经使用 DeepSeek Harness？Oh Story DSH 将四套技能整合到它的工作台中。这是该宿主的社区插件，不是安装到普通 DeepSeek 网页聊天里的扩展。
